rows.label: Redeemer Prime Blade
rows.note: Lith D5 or Lith L2 or Lith M5 or Lith N9 or Meso Z2 or Neo G2 or Neo N10 or Neo P1 or Neo S12 or Neo T3, Common: 25.33% Intact

conditions: Refine the Rare and Uncommon relics to Radiant (100 Void Traces each); leave Blade relics Intact, since Radiant lowers their Common odds to 16.67%.
Mission rewards never drop Resurgence relics; Varzia is the only source.
bonuses: Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
